nodes.name: NiFe-LDH coprecipitation
nodes.procedure: The Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}-LDH was prepared via a coprecipitation method using 0.1 M aqueous solutions of Ni(NO_{3})_{2} and Fe(NO_{3})_{3} as metal precursors with Ni:Fe = 3:1. The synthesis was conducted at 80°C. To begin, 10 mL of deionized water was added to a 0.1 M Na_{2}CO_{3} solution, adjusted to pH 9.0. A mixed metal nitrate solution containing 0.3 M total metals (Ni:Fe = 3:1, thus ~0.225 M Ni(NO3)2 and ~0.075 M Fe(NO3)3) was then slowly introduced into the carbonate solution over 1.5 h. During the process, the pH was maintained around 9.0 by co-feeding 0.1 M Na_{2}CO_{3} solution. After precipitation, the suspension was centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 5 min to collect the solid product, which was subsequently dried at 120°C for 48 h.

nodes.name: NiFe chloride precatalyst ink
nodes.procedure: To synthesize the NiFeCl precatalyst ink, NiCl2 and FeCl3 were dissolved in water with a molar ratio of 4:1 (Ni:Fe = 3:1 atomic, corresponding to Ni0.75Fe0.25) at a concentration of 5 mg mL^{-1}. 0.05 mL of this solution was diluted in isopropanol/water (v/v = 1:4), followed by addition of 1 mg acetylene black (AB) and 0.05 mL Na+-exchanged Nafion binder. Final ink volume adjusted to 1 mL.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS shows Fe/Ni ratio decrease after 10 CV cycles for Ni0.75Fe0.25-LDH indicating Fe loss from bulk, with small changes after CA in single cell and H-cell with CEM, but notable increase after CA in H-cell with AEM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2a summarizes the Fe/Ni ratio measured on Ni0.75Fe0.25-LDH by inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) ... a notable increase was observed after CA in the H-cell with AEM.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM-EDS shows lower surface Fe/Ni ratio than ICP-MS after 10 CVs for Ni0.75Fe0.25-LDH indicating surface Fe loss, small change after CA in single cell/CEM, notable increase after AEM CA.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM-EDX offers insight into the near-surface composition ... even lower Fe/Ni ratio was detected by SEM-EDX, which suggests Fe loss from surface region.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows very weak Fe signal after 10 CVs, no increase after single cell/CEM CA, but notable Fe 3p signal after H-cell AEM CA for Ni0.75Fe0.25-LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was carried out to study the surface Ni and Fe species on Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}-LDH after electrochemical reactions ... notable XPS signal of Fe 3p presented after CA performance in H-cell with AEM.

nodes.evidence_snippet: The derived NiFe oxyhydroxides have been characterized by Raman spectroscopy, which validates the cation vacancies after Zn leaching (Supplementary Fig. 13).
